reason: I don't trust an AI with my money, and a cartoon pet running my portfolio makes it feel more like a game than an adviser. I already check my broker app every day and make my own trades, so I don't need something to do it for me, let alone pay monthly for it.
objection: There's no broker named yet and no price, and it's all demo money today. I'd be handing real cash to an AI from a company I've never heard of, and a downloadable log doesn't help much once a bad trade has already gone through.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker holding the money with SIPC coverage, plus a year or more of real-money results I could check, from a source I trust and not from the app itself.
